name: New Orleans Pelicans
notes: Founded: NBA.com gives 2002 (the Hornets' move from Charlotte; renamed Pelicans in 2013). The 2012 purchase by Tom Benson ($338M, per Front Office Sports) predates the 2015 deal window so it is not listed as a deal. Forbes shows no Owner(s) line for the Pelicans; ownership is from FOS and the team's 2025-26 media guide (Gayle Benson, Governor; Dennis Lauscha, President). Front Office Sports notes Benson founded Benson Capital Partners, but no fund holds a stake in the team on any page read. Capacity: media guide 16,867 for Pelicans games (18,500 max); Forbes 17,188. Press in 2026 reports a planned Smoothie King Center renovation and a new long-term state lease expected in autumn 2026; not recorded (no figures read). Revenue etc. are Forbes 2024-25 estimates. Jersey patch release dates from September 2024. Legal entity, attendance and social counts not found.

owners.evidence: Tom Benson died in 2018, and his wife, Gayle Benson, now controls the Saints and Pelicans
owners.name: Gayle Benson

ownership_summary: Gayle Benson owns and governs the Pelicans (and the NFL's New Orleans Saints). Her late husband Tom Benson bought the then-Hornets from the NBA in 2012 for $338 million; she took control on his death in March 2018. No institutional or minority stake sale has been reported on the pages read.
